Aleks,

Thank you very much for your interest in this project. You've got a
jump on the process, as you probably know from your application last
year. Although I haven't sketched out specifics of the project, yet,
take a look at the references and consider working up a function that
fits the description I've laid out in the "test" section. Also, think
about how you would structure a project, including a timeline. I know
you don't have all the specifics, but we'll have time to modify any
initial draft.

pcc
